resources.string: Unreel watches the Instagram app and hides the Reels tab and closes any Reels that open. It only reads the Instagram screen, never collects or sends any data.

Unreel hides the Reels button in Instagram and kicks you out of Reels whenever they open (also Reels from the feed, Explore or DMs).\n\nIt works through Android\'s Accessibility service, so you need to switch it on once.

In Accessibility settings: tap \"Installed apps\" / \"Downloaded apps\" → \"Unreel – Reels blocker\" → turn it on.\n\nOn Android 13+ the switch may be greyed out for sideloaded apps. Then go to Settings → Apps → Unreel → ⋮ (top right) → \"Allow restricted settings\" and try again.
